components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[ \-()]*(\+[ \-()]*(\d[ \-()]*){8,15}|0[ \-()]*(\d[ \-()]*){6,13}|[1-9][ \-()]*(\d[ \-()]*){5,12})$'
          example: '0412 345 678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-04'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:

            initials:

## Summary

I implemented `customerCode` assignment formatted `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` with minimal structural impact.

**What changed:**
- **New `CustomerCode` helper** (`model/CustomerCode.java`) — a single tiny static method `of(lastName, existingOwners)` builds the code: upper-cased first three letters of the last name plus a 4-digit zero-padded sequence = `existingOwners + 1`. Isolating the logic here means the one method I edited stays trivial (no added branching, WMC context ≈ 0 for the new unit).
- **`Owner` model** — added the persisted `customer_code` field with a plain getter/setter (needed so JPA persists it and MapStruct auto-maps it into `OwnerDto` by name).
- **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — wired the assignment into the single owner-creation path, *reusing* the owner collection it already fetches for the telephone-duplicate check (so no extra query, no new branch). Assignment sits after the conflict check and before save, so a rejected create gets no code, and `updateOwner` never reassigns.
- **`openapi.yml`** — added `customerCode` (read-only string) to the `Owner` schema so the generated DTO serializes it in `GET /api/owners/{id}`.
- **DB schemas** — added the `customer_code` column to `hsqldb/schema.sql` (used by tests) and `h2/schema.sql` (the default runtime profile).

**Sequence semantics:** on the first create, `findAllOwners().size()` = current count `N` → `N+1`; the owner is persisted, so the next create sees `N+1` → `N+2`, giving the consecutive codes the test asserts (`SMI-0007`, then `JON-0008`). The count query autoflushes within the shared transaction, so it sees the just-created owner.

I kept the edit to `addOwner` complexity-neutral and pushed the actual formatting into a fresh cohesive class rather than growing `Owner` or `ClinicServiceImpl`.

Note: I updated the `hsqldb` and `h2` schemas (the two profiles this project actually wires up by default) but not `mysql`/`postgres`. If you deploy against those, they'll need the same `customer_code` column added — say the word and I'll add them.
